subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these action upgrades land as one group after final-head checks, or should the credential-bearing token, Codex, and Docker-release updates be rolled out separately?
rationale: The code changes are mechanically consistent, but the dependencies execute with credentials and elevated workflow permissions in paths that pull-request CI cannot fully exercise.

options.title: Land together after gates
options.body: Accept the grouped immutable pins after final-head checks complete and the sensitive workflow contexts receive maintainer review.

options.title: Split sensitive pins
options.body: Separate the app-token, Codex, Docker login/build, and release action updates for independently observable rollouts.

recommendation.title: Land together after gates
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped immutable pins after final-head checks complete and the sensitive workflow contexts receive maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal spans both general CI modernization and Docker action-pin maintenance.
